facts.evidence: NVIDIA reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% year over year ... Revenue was $96,221 million, up 18% sequentially and up 106% year over year.

GAAP net income was $59,688 million (up 2% sequentially, 126% year over year) and GAAP diluted EPS was $2.46. Non-GAAP net income was $53,954 million (up 18% sequentially) and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $2.22.
Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion, up 18% sequentially and 117% year over year.
GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were both 75.0%, versus 72.4% (GAAP) and 72.5% (non-GAAP) a year ago.
Q3 FY27 guidance: revenue of $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, assuming no Data Center compute revenue from China
The Vera Rubin platform is ramping into full production with racks running at CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius.
Approximately $26.0 billion was returned in the quarter via repurchases and dividends; approximately $99.0 billion remained under authorization.

GAAP other income, net was $7,773 million and included $7,771 million of gains from equity securities, net, which the non-GAAP reconciliation excludes — the main reason GAAP and non-GAAP results diverge this quarter.
Edge Computing revenue was $7.2 billion, up 13% sequentially and 27% year over year

claims.claim: NVIDIA reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% year over year.
claims.note: Release headline bullet and opening paragraph.

claims.claim: NVIDIA guided third-quarter revenue to $108.0 billion while assuming no Data Center compute revenue from China.
claims.note: Outlook section.

claims.claim: Revenue was $96,221 million.
claims.note: Income statement, three months ended July 26, 2026.

claims.claim: Revenue was up 18% sequentially.
claims.note: Q2 FY27 summary table Q/Q of 18.

claims.claim: Revenue was up 106% year over year.
claims.note: Q2 FY27 summary table Y/Y of 106.

claims.claim: Six-month (first-half fiscal 2027) revenue was $177,837 million.
claims.note: Income statement, six months ended July 26, 2026.

claims.claim: GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were both 75.0% in the quarter.
claims.note: Opening paragraph and reconciliation.

claims.claim: Year-ago gross margins were 72.4% GAAP and 72.5% non-GAAP.
claims.note: Summary table, Q2 FY26 column.

claims.claim: GAAP operating income was $63,734 million, up 124% year over year.
claims.note: Summary table GAAP operating income and Y/Y of 124.

claims.claim: Non-GAAP operating income was $63,956 million.
claims.note: Non-GAAP summary table and reconciliation.

claims.claim: GAAP net income was $59,688 million, up 2% sequentially and 126% year over year.
claims.note: Summary table GAAP net income with Q/Q 2 and Y/Y 126.

claims.claim: GAAP diluted EPS was $2.46.
claims.note: Summary table and income statement.

claims.claim: Non-GAAP net income was $53,954 million, up 18% sequentially.
claims.note: Non-GAAP summary table with Q/Q of 18.

claims.claim: Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $2.22.
claims.note: Non-GAAP summary table and reconciliation.

claims.claim: GAAP other income, net was $7,773 million.
claims.note: Income statement and reconciliation, three months ended July 26, 2026.

claims.claim: GAAP other income included $7,771 million of gains from equity securities, net, which the non-GAAP reconciliation excludes.
claims.note: Reconciliation line 'Gains from equity securities, net (7,771)'.

claims.claim: The equity securities gains are the main reason GAAP and non-GAAP results diverge this quarter.
claims.note: Reconciliation shows the $7,771M equity gain dwarfs the other adjustments ($222M operating, $298M other) in the $7,251M pre-tax total.

claims.claim: GAAP operating expenses were $8,408 million, up 55% year over year.
claims.note: Summary table GAAP opex and Y/Y of 55.

claims.claim: Non-GAAP operating expenses were $8,232 million.
claims.note: Non-GAAP summary table and reconciliation.

claims.claim: Beginning in Q1 FY27, non-GAAP measures no longer exclude stock-based compensation, and historical non-GAAP information has been restated to include it.
claims.note: Non-GAAP Measures section.

claims.claim: Stock-based compensation was $2,027 million in the quarter.
claims.note: Cash flow statement, three months ended July 26, 2026.

claims.claim: Operating cash flow was $24,077 million, versus $50,344 million in Q1 FY27.
claims.note: Cash flow statement and reconciliation column for April 26, 2026 quarter.

claims.claim: Free cash flow (non-GAAP) was $21,341 million.
claims.note: Reconciliation free cash flow line; release defines free cash flow as a non-GAAP measure.

claims.claim: Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion, up 18% sequentially and 117% year over year.
claims.note: Data Center highlights bullet.

claims.claim: The Vera Rubin platform is ramping into full production with racks running at CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius.
claims.note: Data Center highlights bullet.

claims.claim: Edge Computing revenue was $7.2 billion, up 13% sequentially and 27% year over year.
claims.note: Edge Computing highlights bullet.

claims.claim: Edge Computing highlights included RTX Spark with Microsoft, DGX Station for Windows and DRIVE Hyperion.
claims.note: All three appear in Edge Computing highlights.

claims.claim: NVIDIA announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish compute financing platforms intended to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital over time, subject to definitive agreements.
claims.note: Data Center highlights bullet on independent compute financing platforms.

claims.claim: Sovereign activity cited includes Korea (SK Telecom, NAVER, Brookfield), Japan's national AI infrastructure, and a record 35 new AI HPC supercomputers in development across Europe.
claims.note: Three separate Data Center highlights bullets.

claims.claim: Q3 FY27 revenue guidance is $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, assuming no Data Center compute revenue from China.
claims.note: Outlook section.

claims.claim: Q3 FY27 GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are guided to 74.0%, plus or minus 50 basis points.
claims.note: Outlook section and non-GAAP outlook reconciliation.

claims.claim: Q3 FY27 operating expenses are guided to approximately $9.2 billion GAAP and $9.0 billion non-GAAP.
claims.note: Outlook section.

claims.claim: Full-year FY27 GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates are expected at 16.0%-18.0%, excluding discrete items.
claims.note: Outlook section (release also excludes material changes to the tax environment).

claims.claim: Approximately $26.0 billion was returned to shareholders in the quarter via repurchases and dividends.
claims.note: Capital return paragraph.

claims.claim: Approximately $99.0 billion remained under the share repurchase authorization.
claims.note: As of end of second quarter, per release.

claims.claim: The next quarterly dividend is $0.25 per share, payable October 1, 2026 to holders of record September 10, 2026.
claims.note: Dividend paragraph.

claims.claim: Cash and equivalents were $22,443 million versus $10,605 million at January 25, 2026.
claims.note: Balance sheet.

claims.claim: Accounts receivable were $63,059 million versus $38,466 million at January 25, 2026.
claims.note: Balance sheet.

claims.claim: Inventories were $31,575 million versus $21,403 million at January 25, 2026.
claims.note: Balance sheet.

claims.claim: Long-term debt was $32,366 million versus $7,469 million at January 25, 2026.
claims.note: Balance sheet.

claims.claim: Debt issuance proceeds, net of costs, were $24,896 million in the quarter.
claims.note: Cash flow statement, three months ended July 26, 2026.

claims.claim: Non-marketable securities were $51,157 million versus $22,251 million at January 25, 2026.
claims.note: Balance sheet.

claims.claim: Marketable equity securities were $42,783 million versus $12,886 million at January 25, 2026.
claims.note: Balance sheet.

claims.claim: Guidance excludes China Data Center compute revenue entirely.

claims.claim: Receivables and inventories both rose materially since January 25, 2026.

claims.note: Reconciliation shows both quarterly figures side by side.

claims.claim: Guided gross margin of 74.0% sits below the 75.0% reported this quarter.
claims.note: Outlook versus reported gross margin, both stated in release.

claims.claim: Equity-securities gains drove GAAP-only earnings, and the equity and non-marketable securities positions are growing.
claims.note: Gains excluded from non-GAAP per reconciliation; balance sheet shows both securities balances increased since January 25, 2026.

claims.claim: The $500 billion financing platforms remain subject to definitive agreements.
